data.name: Dharani
data.gender_notes: Dharani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Dharani represents the earth element and the stabilizing force that grounds us. It is the divine power that bestows the gift of stability, grounding, and security. The name Dharani carries the meaning “Firm ground, stability” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dharani usually hope their child will grow to embody firm ground, stability and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Connects us to the earth and provides stability and grounding.
data.etymology: Dharani belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firm ground, stability.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dharani total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

It is revered in Hinduism as a symbol of the ground beneath our feet that provides us with a solid base in life. In various rituals and practices, Dharani is invoked to bring about prosperity, longevity, and protection.

By invoking the name Dharani, one can tap into this fundamental force of life, finding inner peace, protection, and serenity.
